title: Photograph 5
passage: A. One hand is resting on the smaller yellow wheel. B. Both of the worker’s hands are on the same wheel. C. The worker is holding a wrench against a pipe. D. One of the worker’s hands is resting on a blue wheel.
passageZh:
A. 有一隻手搭在較小的黃色手輪上。

C. 作業員正拿扳手抵著管子。
D. 作業員有一隻手搭在藍色手輪上。
